description: Discover sittings with mode sittings and year; default decisions pages compact summaries with labels and separate decided-on and recording document relations for sitting_id. Optional document_id filters decisions before paging by exact document identity or hyphen-boundary descendant. Mode decision requires decision_id and returns one rich record with reference text and commentary; it rejects nondefault paging and snapshot. Optional decision-only mep_id returns independent recorded and intended positions with publication availability, without a roster lookup; empty positions do not prove absence from the vote. Mode voters requires decision_id and one position, paging recorded and intended voters independently. Missing arrays succeed with available false; published empty arrays have available true. Optional resolve_names requires explicit roster_term and joins only published names from that complete term roster, never voting-date affiliations or current-roster substitutes. Some IDs may remain unresolved. Continue local decisions or voters with page.next_offset and snapshot; restart at offset 0 without snapshot after snapshot_changed. Missing sitting decisions succeed empty; absent selected decision fails decision_not_found.

decision_id.description: Required for decision and voters: exact returned canonical decision ID, known eli/dl/event/ prefix, or exact public event URI; forbidden for sittings and decisions.

document_id.description: Decisions-only document filter: canonical ID, eli/dl/doc/ prefix or exact public URI. Matches decided-on or recording relations by exact ID or hyphen-boundary descendant before paging.

language.description: Supported EU ISO-639-1 language, case-insensitive; default en; source text is never translated.

limit.description: Whole items requested; default 20, effective maximum 100 with notice.

mep_id.description: Decision-only member lookup: canonical numeric ID, person/ prefix or exact public person URI. Uses published arrays without a roster join; empty positions do not prove absence from the vote.

mode.description: Default decisions returns compact summaries; sittings discovers by year, decision returns one rich record, voters pages one position.

position.description: Required only for voters: favor, against, abstention, intended_favor, intended_against, or intended_abstention.

resolve_names.description: Default false retains IDs only; true is voters-only and requires roster_term for complete names-only roster resolution.

roster_term.description: Explicit parliamentary term 0–10 containing the sitting; required with resolve_names true, forbidden otherwise. No term is inferred from dates.

sitting_id.description: Required outside sittings: real YYYY-MM-DD date, MTG-PL-YYYY-MM-DD, known event prefix, or exact public event URI.

snapshot.description: Returned decisions or voter-position snapshot; required for local offset above 0, optional at offset 0; forbidden for sittings and decision.

year.description: Four-digit year, required only for sittings and forbidden in other modes.

Declared by this tool: `invalid_filter`: Identifier, calendar date, year, term, or language is unsupported. `invalid_mode_fields`: Required mode fields are missing, incompatible fields are supplied, or local continuation lacks a snapshot. `snapshot_changed`: Complete selected decisions, voters, resolved names, or normalized retrieval scope changed. `decision_not_found`: The selected decision is absent from the complete sitting collection. `upstream_paging_stalled`: Complete name-resolution roster acquisition repeats a page before exhaustion. `upstream_rejected`: Parliament rejects validated request parameters. `upstream_rate_limited`: Parliament rate limits persist after bounded retries. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.
